paragraphs.text: The choir rehearses on Thursdays from 7 pm to 9 pm in the church hall on Bridge Lane. There is no audition, but new singers are asked to attend three rehearsals before the winter concert.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The fee is £60 a term, or £20 for students. Music is provided; singers bring a pencil and a folder. The choir performs four concerts a year and has sung in the cathedral twice since 2019.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: On which evening does the choir rehearse?
How many rehearsals must a new singer attend before the concert?
How much does a student pay each term?
What must singers bring besides a folder?

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Find the answer in the text. You have 20 seconds for each question. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.
